acme_prod_sre: Hey team — after the allocator rollout on 2026-03-12 (~03:22 UTC) our production integration started seeing tool/function calls either dropped or returned with wrong args. Happening for multiple customers but started coincident with that rollout. example request_id=req_9a3f7c, model=redwood-v2.1-512, variant=fast-quantized, rollout-tag=allocator-2026-03-12. Can someone triage?

alice_support: Sorry about the disruption :wave: Could you paste a minimal repro (request body + actual API response)? Region and org id would help too.

acme_prod_sre: Pasting redacted minimal repro below. This used to trigger a single tool call `fetch_user` with kwargs {"user_id": "u-1234"} and then the integration would make an HTTP call. Now the response either has tool_calls: [] or the tool_call has a different name and arg order.

acme_prod_sre: ```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Body:
{
  "model": "redwood-v2.1-512",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Get user info for  u-1234"}],
  "tools": [
    {"name":"fetch_user","params_schema":{"user_id":"string"}},
    {"name":"log_event","params_schema":{"event":"string","meta":"object"}}
  ],
  "request_id": "req_9a3f7c"
}
```

acme_prod_sre: Actual API response we got: ```
{
  "request_id":"req_9a3f7c",
  "model":"redwood-v2.1-512",
  "tool_calls": [],
  "diagnostics": ["fnbridge:dropped_invocation","mapper:v2:applied-reorder"]
}
```

acme_prod_sre: And in another case we got: ```
{
  "request_id":"req_b7d2f",
  "tool_calls":[{"name":"log_event","args":["u-1234","fetch_attempt"]}],
  "diagnostics":["mapper:v2:positionalized-kwargs"]
}
```

alice_support: Thanks — that helps. Noted the mapper:v2 diagnostics. @carol_runtime any idea if request-mapper or allocator changes could cause dropped tool invocations or argument reshaping?

carol_runtime: Looking. We pushed allocator-2026-03-12 + request-mapper v2 at the same time. Mapper v2 includes a canonicalizer that normalizes tool call tokens into positional args in some cases (intended to help older model variants). Sounds like canonicalizer is being too aggressive for structured tool outputs from v2.1.

carol_runtime: Quick triage steps for support/ops: 1) capture raw model proto before mapper (we need raw_tool_call payload), 2) compare mapper input vs output, 3) if urgent, pin traffic for the org to mapper-v1.

alice_support: Can you list the commands to pin traffic? Customer is requesting immediate mitigation.

bob_oncall: Re-route command (internal):
```
redwood route set --org acme-corp --map-version v1 --model redwood-v2.1-512 --note "pin mapper v1 for acme after allocator rollout"
```
If operations prefers a rollback of allocator rollout:
```
deployctl rollback allocator allocator-2026-03-12
```
Both are low-risk and can be done ASAP.

dave_ml: From an ML-side perspective, v2.1 changed how function call tokens are emitted for zero-shot tool invocation. Mapper-v2's canonicalizer assumes a different tokenization boundary and sometimes flattens kwargs into positional lists. That lines up with the diagnostics you posted.

dave_ml: Short-term: pin to mapper-v1 for affected orgs. Medium-term: we'll update the canonicalizer to preserve explicit kwargs when model-provided tool_call has a params object. I have a PR started: https://git.internal/redwood/mapper/pull/382 (WIP).

deploy-bot: Canary release allocator-2026-03-12 observed by canary-runner: 2026-03-12 03:22 UTC -> 5% canary -> healthy at 5% (metrics ok). Canary notes: added request-mapper v2.

carol_runtime: I've started a scoped rollback for acme org now (pin to mapper-v1). Will monitor for 10m and then widen if stable.

acme_prod_sre: Thanks — pin looks like it fixed one reproduction case immediately. tool_calls reappeared and args match expected shape. :relieved: Please keep us posted on permanent fix ETA.

erin_cs: Escalating to priority-high. I'll update the customer with mitigation steps and an FAQ entry. Can engineering add a short postmortem draft once the root cause is fixed?

carol_runtime: Confirmed: pinning mapper-v1 fixed immediate symptoms for acme and two other affected customers. We're merging the canonicalizer fix (tests + integration) and will canary mapper-v2 patch to 5% in staging later today. ETA for wide rollout: ~4 hours after canary if no regressions.

dave_ml: PR will include an extra signal check: if model output contains explicit params object, do not positionalize. Tests added.

bob_oncall: I'll keep the rollback command ready and watch the alerting dashboard (toolcall-drop-rate metric) for spikes.

erin_cs: Customer updated. They want a final RCA and closure once fix is live.

alice_support: Filing support ticket and linking to engineering PR and rollback details. Thanks everyone — great cross-team response.

acme_prod_sre: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please confirm when mapper-v2 patch is fully rolled out so we can remove the org pin.

carol_runtime: Will post final status in this thread when mapper-v2 patched rollout completes.
